items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I’ve played with Maxwell for five years, and in 2009 when he came back with “Pretty Wings” and all that stuff, so I did that tour, from ’09 to 2013

ctx.x: I’ll bet you’re a musician. MW: Your church background I think is just fabulous. Do you see any way in the immediate future on your event horizon where you can kind of revolutionize, particularly in black churches, what the black pastors will let the young musicians do?

I think that’s already changing. Granted, they kicked me out of church in ’99. Footnote, I got kicked out. But thank God, when I was playing in church in Houston when I got a scholarship to come to New York, my pastor in Houston led this church called Brentwood Baptist Church, and my pastor said, “I’m going to call my boy up in Harlem and you’re going to play at his church when you get there.” So I had a good job the first week I got to New York. I got to New York, they put me over to the male chorus first of…
